Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's side control and north-south attacks (your copy has 7 files; the publisher lists 8 sections). It covers the battle for inside position, dealing with the near-side underhook and side guard, isolating the far arm and then the near arm (shin pin to kimura or side triangle), moving to north-south and entering the legs from side control, and attacking from north-south (securing the kimura, figure-four back head-and-arm). It ends with rolls and commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi top players who pin well but don't submit from side control.
key: Isolating the far and near arm

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's armbar course in eight parts (7+ hours), with rolling footage and commentary. It covers the mechanics of juji gatame, controlling the arm and breaking grips, and armbar entries from guard, mount, side control and the back, organised as a system so the armbar links with his other attacks. The publisher listing doesn't break the volumes down.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi grapplers who want a complete armbar game.
key: Entries from guard, mount, side and back

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's back attack system, developed with John Danaher, in eight volumes. Volume 1 covers exploiting the body's asymmetry and control mechanisms. Volume 2 covers keeping control when the opponent clears a hook (butterfly hook, high ball ride, re-inserting hooks). Volume 3 covers the underhook side and re-attacking with good head position. Volume 4 covers recovering head position when the opponent escapes to the underhook side. Volume 5 covers elbow pummelling, and using extraction and cross-wrist grips against it. Volume 6 covers attacking from the underhook side (single and double cross-wrist dilemmas). Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls, with and without commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi grapplers who take the back but can't finish.
key: Re-inserting hooks and high ball ride
